# appstore-v1_signing_key (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) name of the SigningKey

### Optional

- `hash` (String) resource content will be returned as it was at the time of this git hash

### Read-Only

- `alarms` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alarms))
- `api_version` (String)
- `deviations` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deviations))
- `kind` (String)
- `metadata` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `spec` (Attributes) SigningKeySpec defines the desired state of a SigningKey. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec))
- `status` (Attributes) SigningKeyStatus defines the observed state of a SigningKey. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))

<a id="nestedatt--alarms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `alarms`

Read-Only:

- `critical` (Number)
- `major` (Number)
- `minor` (Number)
- `warning` (Number)


<a id="nestedatt--deviations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `deviations`

Read-Only:

- `count` (Number)


<a id="nestedatt--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Read-Only:

- `annotations` (Map of String)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `name` (String)
- `namespace` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Read-Only:

- `public_keys` (Attributes List) PublicKeys is the non-empty list of trusted cosign-compatible public keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--public_keys))

<a id="nestedatt--spec--public_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.public_keys`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) Key is the PKIX PEM-encoded public key (e.g. -----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----).
- `title` (String) Title optionally identifies this key for status messages and debugging.



<a id="nestedatt--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status`

Read-Only:

- `error` (String) Error describes the last validation failure (e.g. which publicKeys entry failed to parse).
- `last_refresh_time` (String) LastRefreshTime is the last time the controller validated spec.publicKeys.
- `loaded` (Boolean) Loaded is true when every entry in spec.publicKeys parsed successfully as a public key.
- `loaded_key_count` (Number) LoadedKeyCount is the number of successfully parsed public keys on the last reconcile.
